title: Warhammer Blood Bowl delayed to spring 2027 🏈
subject: bloodbowl
description:
Will you wait for it or stick with the beta? 👇

Warhammer Blood Bowl, the free upgrade to Blood Bowl 3, has been delayed from Q4 2026 to spring 2027. Slitherine announced it in Berlin on November 7, 2026, citing an Xbox issue and a same-day launch on all platforms. Tomb Kings and Bretonnians come free with the base game.

Sources: Wargamer (Nov 7, 2026), PC Gamer (Nov 9, 2026)
Game footage © Games Workshop, Cyanide Studio and Slitherine.

scenes.text: Warhammer Blood Bowl has slipped to spring 2027.
Slitherine announced the delay on stage in Berlin on November 7.
Programmer Mathieu Valero pointed to an issue on Xbox. The team wants every platform to launch on the same day.
It was last set for late 2026, after Nacon sold developer Cyanide to Slitherine in July.
Two new teams, the Tomb Kings and the Bretonnians, come free in the base game.
Blood Bowl 3 owners get the upgrade at no cost, keeping their teams and cosmetics.
